lines.text: The root is Cide! Concise, incision.
Cide is Latin for cut or kill.
Quick quiz! Which means into plus cut?

words.ex: A strong introduction is concise and direct.
The surgeon made a small incision in the abdomen.

publish.title: Cide root: concise and incision
publish.value: Cide comes from Latin "caedere" (to cut, to kill). Words: concise and incision. concise = con + cise; incision = in + cis.
